label: Grand Landscape
description: The landform as hero: nature subject x weather x light on a large-format field camera, printed at gallery scale.
prefix: A grand landscape photograph in the tradition of the great large-format masters — a heavy field camera on a tripod, one sheet exposed after hours of waiting, the landform portrayed with the patience and reverence usually reserved for portraiture. Nothing man-made in frame.
suffix: Print Standard: front-to-back critical sharpness from the tilted 4x5 focal plane, tonal honesty — in color or monochrome — with no artificial saturation push, depth that survives a two-meter gallery print, the light doing all the drama.
negative: watermark, text, people, buildings, powerlines, roads, vehicles, HDR halos
